title: Strongly Connected Components (Kosaraju)
summary: Count the groups of vertices that can all reach each other in a directed graph: one depth-first search records the finish order, then a second search along the reversed edges, started from the last finished vertex, collects one group at a time.

inputs.name: values
inputs.label: Directed edges
inputs.hint: Edges as pairs: from, to. For example 0, 1, 1, 2 means 0→1 and 1→2. Do not list both directions of the same pair.

inputs.name: vertices
inputs.label: Number of vertices
inputs.hint: From 1 to 8. Vertices are numbered 0 up to one less than this number.
